description: Metrics storage, logging, and event tracking for tunnel operations

requirements.title: Metrics time-series storage
requirements.description: Store scraped cloudflared metrics (HA connections, error rate, RTT, active streams) in PostgreSQL with timestamps. Retain 7 days of 1-minute resolution data.

requirements.title: Metric data model
requirements.description: Store metric name, value, and timestamp as time-series rows in PostgreSQL

requirements.title: Metric retention policy
requirements.description: Automatically purge metric records older than 7 days to control storage growth

requirements.title: Metric query API
requirements.description: Expose API endpoints to query stored metrics with time range and metric name filters

requirements.title: Probe history storage
requirements.description: Store probe results per route in PostgreSQL: timestamp, route, internal result, external result, classification, response time. Retain 7 days.

requirements.title: Probe result schema
requirements.description: Store per-route probe data: timestamp, route ID, internal result, external result, classification, response time

requirements.title: Probe history retention
requirements.description: Automatically purge probe records older than 7 days

requirements.title: Probe history query API
requirements.description: Expose API endpoints to query probe history with route and time range filters

requirements.title: Structured logging
requirements.description: All operations logged with structured fields: component, action, result, duration, error. Log to stderr in JSON format for journalctl compatibility.

requirements.title: JSON log format
requirements.description: Output structured logs in JSON format to stderr for journalctl and log aggregation compatibility

requirements.title: Log field structure
requirements.description: Each log entry includes component, action, result, duration, and error fields

requirements.title: Health API endpoint
requirements.description: GET /api/v1/health/detailed returns composite tunnel health for other Vrooli scenarios (e.g., vrooli-autoheal) to consume. Includes route-level status summary.
